comment: What to download, per system - read by the release notes (.github/scripts/release-notes.py), the download page (tools/changelog-site.js) and the AppImage's own setup (install.js, beside this file). The names are electron-builder.yml's artifactName for each target.

files.label: Windows
files.note: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit. Installs for you alone, without asking for an administrator.

files.label: macOS, Apple silicon
files.note: Macs with an M1 chip or later - most Macs from 2021 on.

files.label: Linux: Ubuntu, Debian, Mint
files.note: Opens in your software centre to install.

files.label: Linux: Fedora, RHEL, openSUSE
files.note: Opens in your software centre to install.

files.label: Linux: any other
files.note: One file that runs anywhere and updates itself. Make it executable, then open it.
